SYNTHETIC TEST JOB DESCRIPTION — Frontend React and Accessibility Engineer
Company: Example Frontend Labs (fictional)
Location: Boston / Remote, United States

Responsibilities and selection priorities
Build accessible React and Next.js workflows in TypeScript. Prioritize keyboard navigation, screen-reader labels, reusable form components, validation and responsive UI. Write Playwright end-to-end tests. Strong evidence of accessible component and dashboard work matters more than backend tracing or data pipelines.

Required qualifications
- React
- Next.js
- TypeScript
- accessible
- keyboard
- Playwright

Preferred, not mandatory
- Vue

Applications are assessed on demonstrated work. Candidates may apply without preferred tools. Do not claim skills you have not used.
